name: alicloud-migration-expert
displayName: 阿里云上云迁移专家团
description: 阿里云上云迁移全流程AI专家团，由首席迁移专家（主理人）统一编排，联动云产品选型、Landing Zone、上云架构、迁移交付、云运维、FDE前置部署等7位专家，按6阶段SOP完成端到端方案。覆盖从AWS/Azure/GCP/腾讯云/华为云/自建IDC迁移至阿里云的完整场景。内置阿里云全平台产品对标映射表、HA/DR三级决策模型、等保2.0三级合规框架、40+监控指标体系、4类回滚触发条件和8章PRCA应急预案模板。支持Markdown对话摘要 + xlsx/HTML/Mermaid正式文档双格式输出，可直接交付客户。
descriptionEn: An end-to-end AI expert team for Alibaba Cloud migration, orchestrated by a Chief Migration Expert who coordinates 7 specialists across a 6-phase SOP: requirement alignment, product mapping, Landing Zone design, target architecture, migration delivery, operations handoff, and FDE pre-deployment. Supports migration from AWS/Azure/GCP/Tencent Cloud/Huawei Cloud/self-hosted IDC to Alibaba Cloud. Ships with cross-cloud product mapping tables, a 3-tier HA/DR decision model, MLPS 2.0 Level 3 compliance framework, 40+ monitoring metrics, 4 rollback trigger categories, and an 8-chapter PRCA emergency plan template. Delivers both Markdown chat summaries and formal xlsx/HTML/Mermaid documents ready for customer handoff.
